location: Nauvis - New Dawn - New Wood Sector
summary: Not too much happened today. Most of the day was spent on general base maintenance and continuing the setup of the new wood production infrastructure.
The expanded forestry sector is slowly taking shape, although it still requires additional construction before reaching its intended capacity.
Aside from building work, I spent time maintaining various parts of the base, clearing minor resource backups, and keeping production lines stable.
During maintenance I decided to remove the furnaces at the original starter iron deposit. The southern iron deposit is now producing more than enough iron plates for the entire base.

Instead of continuing to smelt iron there, the starter iron deposit will now be repurposed to produce steel only. This should simplify the logistics and make better use of the existing infrastructure.

On the technology front, I completed research for Nanobots. This technology should significantly assist with construction and repair tasks, making it much easier to expand infrastructure without having to build everything manually.
I also researched Sand Processing and Landfill. These technologies are mostly quality-of-life improvements but should make future construction far easier.
Landfill will allow me to fill in the small ponds scattered around the area that have been blocking infrastructure expansion.
Sand Processing should also provide additional building materials and help streamline certain production chains later on.
Overall today was mostly preparation work to make future expansion and construction significantly easier.
